```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r data_import}

library(openintro)

data(reddit_finance)
```

```{r cols_selection}

selectedCols = c("fin_indy", # binarna/objaśniana
                 "age", # porządkowa
                 "edu", # porządkowa
                 "gender", # nominalna
                 "rel_status", # nominalna
                 "children", # nominalna
                 "housing", # nominalna
                 "industry", # nominalna
                 "num_incomes", # dyskretna
                 "pan_financial_impact" # porządkowa
                 )

```

```{r selecting_columns}

sort(colSums(is.na(reddit_finance)), decreasing = TRUE)
```

```{r summary_statistics}

sum(complete.cases(reddit_finance[, selectedCols]))

```

```{r checking_data}
lapply(reddit_finance[selectedCols], unique)
```
